headline: Meta reports surging Q3 revenue and profit growth
summary: Meta Platforms reported that its third-quarter profit jumped more than threefold as revenue climbed sharply, while active user accounts expanded.
why: Earnings reports from mega-cap technology firms heavily influence broader market indexes due to their massive market capitalizations and heavy weighting in tech ETFs.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Significantly higher quarterly profits and revenue beat market expectations.

why_moved: Better-than-expected revenue and a threefold jump in profits signaled robust advertising demand and operational efficiency.
